subject_session: all 8 sessions (Achilles_10252013 prototype; Achilles, Cicero, Gatsby, Buddy)

headline_stat.name: fraction of excitatory CA1 units spatially selective (>=1 running condition)

stated_limitation: Caveats: units come from the published spike sorting and the `excitatory` label is taken at face value; place-cell counts depend on the inclusion thresholds for peak rate, spike count and alpha, though the qualitative picture is not sensitive to them; and the reward sites at the ends of the straight tracks mean that occupancy and field density are not uniform along the track.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki dorsal CA1, linear and circular tracks) is the canonical choice for place fields, and the run used all eight sessions across four rats rather than one.
justification.handling: Data are streamed from the archive with LINDI, the mislabelled SpatialSeries rate field is diagnosed and the reconstructed time base is asserted to fall inside MazeEpoch, running epochs are speed-thresholded and direction-split with circular unwrapping on the loop tracks, and unit inclusion (excitatory label, >=50 spikes, >=1 Hz peak) is explicit.
justification.analysis: Skaggs spatial information against a per-unit circular-shift null on a running-only compressed time axis is the standard test, the custom fast rate-map implementation was independently validated against nap.compute_tuning_curves, and odd/even lap stability plus cross-validated Bayesian decoding with a cell-identity shuffle are genuine additional controls (no multiple-comparison correction across units, but at alpha=0.01 this cannot account for 374/562).
justification.correctness: All reported values reproduce the notebook output exactly and sit inside the preregistered ranges (67% selective, 0.70 bits/spike, 0.28 m fields), but the headline 67% is the union across running directions while the per-condition mean is 51% +/- 20% SD, and the README does not label that denominator.
justification.figures: Figures are publication-grade with units, sample sizes and per-session breakdowns; the population maps show a cross-validated diagonal on held-out laps and the decoding panel shows the posterior tracking the animal lap by lap.
justification.honesty: Claims match the analysis output line for line, the write-up flags three concrete methodological traps it hit and names specific scientific caveats (spike-sorting provenance, threshold dependence, non-uniform occupancy at reward sites) rather than generic ones.
